first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The gray road surface that converges from the lower part of the main view toward the far end and curves left around the wall on the left.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A narrow strip of Blue Sky at the upper interior of the top rearview frame, bounded by scene structures.

entities.name: Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall
entities.identification: The band-shaped yellow-and-black protective structure at the far end of the top rearview frame.

entities.name: Gray Concrete Structure
entities.identification: A covered road passage enclosed by a flat gray roof, vertical walls on both sides, and light-gray wall-base plinths.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The low yellow vehicle gradually revealed from the left edge of the main view, with a black tire and silver-gray wheel rim visible in the later portion.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The fixed on-screen interface containing orange text, a horizontal rearview frame at the top, a route map at the lower left, and a circular gauge at the lower right.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The mottled dark- and light-green area in the distance near the exit in the main view.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The nearer silver-white vehicle in the rearview frame, with a dark glass area above its light-colored front, whose image moves from the middle to the left part of the frame.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: The more distant dark-colored vehicle in the right part of the rearview frame, whose image is smaller and has a small amount of light-colored area along its upper part and front edge.
